svg.title: Anatomy of a multi-document QA prompt
svg.desc: An instruction, k documents with one gold answer document, and the question at the end. Dial 1 moves the gold document through positions 1 to k. Dial 2 changes k to 10, 20 or 30.
svg.text: Anatomy of a multi-document QA prompt
One answer document (gold) among k − 1 retrieved distractors (grey). The question (blue) comes last.
Instruction: answer the question using only the
provided search results (some might be irrelevant).
The first Nobel Prize in Physics was ...
Question: who got the first nobel prize in physics
Move only the gold document. Keep the rest.
Add distractors. The correct answer stays the same.
